title: Flood
before: Know your nearest high ground and evacuation route; keep documents in a waterproof bag; store drinking water.
during: Move to higher ground; switch off mains power; never walk or drive through flowing water.
after: Drink only boiled or treated water; avoid wet electrical items; watch for snakes and disease.

title: Flash Flood
regions: Hilly areas, nullahs, urban low-lying zones
before: Do not camp near dry streambeds; track IMD heavy-rain alerts.
during: Climb to higher ground immediately; do not wait for official warning.
after: Stay away from damaged bridges and roads until declared safe.

title: Drought
before: Harvest rainwater; choose drought-tolerant crops; fix leaking taps and pipes.
during: Ration water for drinking first; follow tanker schedules; avoid water-heavy crops.
after: Report crop loss to the local agriculture office to claim relief.

title: Heatwave
regions: Central and North India, April to June
before: Keep ORS and water ready; wear light cotton clothes; plan work before 11 am.
during: Stay indoors at noon; drink water often; check on elders, children and animals.
after: Rest and rehydrate; seek medical help for dizziness, vomiting or very high fever.

title: Lightning
before: Check storm forecasts; identify a sturdy building to shelter in.
during: Leave fields and avoid tall trees; crouch low if caught in the open; stay away from water bodies.
after: Give first aid to victims; they carry no charge. Call an ambulance.

title: Earthquake
before: Fix heavy furniture to walls; keep an emergency kit; practise drop, cover and hold.
during: Drop, cover and hold on; stay away from windows; do not use lifts.
after: Expect aftershocks; check for gas leaks; avoid damaged buildings.

title: Cyclone
before: Secure roofs; stock food, torch and battery radio; know the cyclone shelter location.
during: Stay indoors away from windows; evacuate if ordered; do not go out in the calm eye.
after: Avoid fallen wires; return home only when authorities say it is safe.

title: Landslide
before: Avoid building on steep slopes; watch for cracks and tilting trees after heavy rain.
during: Move sideways out of the debris path, not downhill; alert neighbours.
after: Stay away from the slide area; more slides may follow.

title: Building Fire
before: Know two exits; keep an extinguisher; do not overload sockets.
during: Crawl low under smoke; feel doors before opening; never use lifts; call the fire brigade.
after: Do not re-enter; get checked for smoke inhalation.

title: Forest Fire
before: Clear dry leaves near homes; never leave campfires burning.
during: Move away from the fire against the wind; cover nose with a wet cloth.
after: Avoid ash-covered ground; report smouldering spots.

title: LPG Gas Leak
before: Check the regulator and pipe regularly; keep the kitchen ventilated.
during: Do not switch on any electric item or light a flame; open windows; turn off the regulator.
after: Have the cylinder inspected by the distributor before reuse.

title: Road Accident
before: Wear a helmet or seatbelt; never drink and drive.
during: Call 108; do not move a seriously injured person unless danger persists; control bleeding with clean cloth.
after: Give your honest statement to police; Good Samaritan laws protect helpers.

title: Snakebite
before: Wear boots in fields; use a torch at night; keep grass trimmed.
during: Keep the person calm and still; immobilise the limb; go to hospital for anti-venom at once.
after: Do not cut, suck or tie tightly. Note the snake's look if safe.

title: Dam Release / Breach
regions: Downstream of dams, e.g. Godavari tributaries
before: Learn the dam release alert system; know the evacuation route.
during: Evacuate immediately on siren or alert; help the elderly and children first.
after: Wait for official clearance before going back.

title: Tsunami
before: Know the evacuation signs; stay aware of the INCOIS alerts.
during: After a strong shore quake, go inland or uphill immediately without waiting for a siren.
after: Stay away from the coast; waves can arrive for hours.

title: Crowd Crush / Stampede
before: Note exit routes on arrival; avoid peak crowd times.
during: Move diagonally with the crowd flow; keep arms up to protect your chest; do not bend down.
after: Help the injured and call 108; report missing people.

title: Industrial Chemical Leak
before: Know the factory siren; keep a wet cloth ready.
during: Move crosswind and uphill; close windows; cover nose and mouth.
after: Wash exposed skin; seek medical review.

title: Cold Wave
before: Stock blankets; service heaters; layer clothing.
during: Stay indoors; keep extremities covered; never burn coal in closed rooms.
after: Warm up gradually; seek help for frostbite.
